summary.goal: Transform Planner's PlanVersion into ForgePlan and handle the handoff workflow. Keep Planner and Forge packages independent via this adapter.

acceptance_criteria.description: Fetch approved PlanVersion from Planner API by plan_id and version
Transform PlanVersion steps to ForgeSteps with executable context
Map owner_role (e.g., 'backend:Coder') to agent CLI configuration
Resolve scope to workspace path configuration (scope -> repo URL mapping)
Validate ForgePlan (no orphan dependencies, all criteria present)
Report run status back to Planner - if Planner unreachable, log error and expose via /health/planner-status endpoint, but do NOT block run execution
Send ChangeRequest to Planner when task is blocked and needs plan revision

observations: ForgePlan is the contract - Forge doesn't depend on Planner types directly
Role -> CLI mapping is configuration, not hardcoded
Scope -> repo mapping is project-specific configuration
Planner needs to implement status update endpoint for ac6
patterns: Adapter fetches from Planner, transforms, creates run via Forge API
Configuration file for role->cli and scope->repo mappings
Status webhook or polling from Planner to Forge

steps.title: Create forge configuration schema
steps.description: Define configuration file format for role and scope mappings

acceptance_criteria.description: ForgeConfigSchema with Zod validation
role_cli_mapping: Record<string, { cli: string, timeout?: number, audit?: boolean }>
scope_repo_mapping: Record<string, { repo_url: string, base_branch?: string }>
loadForgeConfig(path) function with validation

steps.title: Create PlannerClient for API access
steps.description: HTTP client for fetching plans from Planner API

acceptance_criteria.description: PlannerClient class with configurable base URL
fetchPlanVersion(planId, version) returns PlanVersion
reportRunStatus(planId, runId, status) - throws PlannerUnavailableError on failure (does not silently continue)
createChangeRequest(planId, changeRequest) sends CR to Planner

architecture.error_handling: All network failures throw typed errors (PlannerUnavailableError, PlanNotFoundError) - no silent failures
architecture.note: reportRunStatus requires Planner to implement POST /plans/:id/run-status endpoint

steps.title: Implement PlanVersion to ForgePlan transformer
steps.description: Transform Planner's PlanVersion into ForgePlan format

acceptance_criteria.description: transformToForgePlan(planVersion, config) returns ForgePlan
Maps PlanVersion.steps to ForgeSteps
Resolves owner_role to CLI config via role_cli_mapping
Resolves scope to repo URL via scope_repo_mapping
Preserves dependencies, acceptance_criteria, gates
Adds resolved fields to ForgeStep: repo_url, cli, audit from config

architecture.pattern: Pure transformation function, no side effects

acceptance_criteria.description: validateForgePlan(plan) checks for issues
Validate: no orphan dependencies (all referenced step_ids exist)
Validate: no cycles in dependency graph
Validate: all steps have repo_url resolved (from config)
Returns { valid: boolean, errors: string[] }

specification.pattern_description: Copy DAG validation pattern from planner-core

steps.title: Create handoff orchestration function
steps.description: High-level function for complete plan handoff

acceptance_criteria.description: startRunFromPlanRef(planId, version, config) orchestrates full handoff
Steps: fetch plan -> transform -> validate -> POST to Forge /runs -> report status
Returns { run_id, tasks_count } on success
Throws descriptive error on validation failure

steps.title: Implement run status reporting to Planner with explicit error handling
steps.description: Report run progress back to Planner for UI visibility, with clear error visibility

acceptance_criteria.description: On run status change, call plannerClient.reportRunStatus()
Status updates: started, paused, completed, failed, cancelled
Include task completion counts in update
On failure: store error in run.planner_sync_error field, expose via GET /runs/:id response
Run continues executing even if Planner reporting fails - but error is VISIBLE not silent
Health endpoint GET /health/planner includes planner_reachable: boolean and last_sync_error if any
Retry failed status updates on next status change (best-effort catch-up)

architecture.integration_point: Hook on run state transition in trajectory capture
architecture.error_visibility: Errors stored in run.planner_sync_error and exposed in API - not logged and forgotten
architecture.retry_strategy: Store pending updates, retry on next state change
architecture.note: Requires Planner to implement POST /plans/:id/run-status endpoint

steps.title: Implement ChangeRequest creation for blocked tasks
steps.description: Send ChangeRequest to Planner when task needs plan revision

acceptance_criteria.description: When task reports blocked with suggested_change, create ChangeRequest
ChangeRequest includes: run_id, task_id, reason, suggested_changes
Link ChangeRequest ID to task for tracking
Pause run awaiting plan revision (optional, configurable)
